extraction.document_summary: Singlife Essential Critical Illness II is a multi-protection critical illness plan that pays a lump-sum upon diagnosis of a covered Critical Illness, Total and Permanent Disability, Terminal Illness, or Death. It is designed to cover people with specified pre-existing conditions, including Type 2 Diabetes, pre-diabetes and/or “the 3 Highs” (high blood pressure, high cholesterol, and high BMI). Applicants complete “just 6 questions” with “no medical check-up needed” if no further medical underwriting is required. Benefit payouts include: (1) standard lump-sum payment tied to the Death Benefit Sum Assured for covered events; (2) a diabetes-related extra lump sum of 20% of the Death Benefit Sum Assured (up to S$25,000 per condition per life); and (3) an extra lump sum for “Angioplasty & Other Invasive Treatment For Coronary Artery” of 10% of Sum Assured (up to S$25,000) that reduces the Sum Assured by the same amount. It also has a no-claims reward of 20% of total premiums paid at the end of the policy term.
quality_notes: Brochure provides clear payout mechanics for the diabetes-related extra payout, angioplasty payout, and no-claims reward.
Some key product underwriting/administration fields (e.g., entry ages, free-look period, full list of TPD/terminal definitions) are not included in the provided text.
No explicit exclusions are stated in the provided excerpt; only limitation/caveat notes are provided.

policies.quick_summary: Multi-protection critical illness plan with lump-sum payouts for covered critical illnesses, TPD, terminal illness and death, with special add-ons for diabetic conditions (extra 20% up to S$25,000/condition) and a separate angioplasty payout (10% up to S$25,000, reducing sum assured by the same amount). Includes a no-claims reward of 20% of total premiums paid at end of term; designed to cover certain pre-existing conditions with a 6-question application (no medical check-up needed if no further underwriting required). Even if a payout has already occurred, the death-related mechanics and diabetic extra benefit rules specify how remaining amounts are determined.
policies.target_customer: Individuals seeking critical illness coverage including those with certain specified pre-existing conditions (e.g., Type 2 Diabetes, pre-diabetes and/or the 3 Highs).
policies.eligibility_notes: Covers certain pre-existing illnesses including Type 2 Diabetes, pre-diabetes and/or high blood pressure, high cholesterol and/or high Body Mass Index, and application involves 6 questions with no medical check-up needed if responses indicate no further medical underwriting is required.
policies.coverage_term_description: Flexible coverage term: “Want coverage for 15 years or up to age 85? Or, how about something in between?”
policies.premium_payment_term_description: Not stated (brochure provides illustrations; does not state premium payment term rules beyond illustration that premiums stop as policy ends).
policies.bonuses_or_dividends: No-claims reward of 20% of total premiums paid at end of policy term.
important_caveats: No medical examination is required if the applicant’s responses to the 6 health questions indicate no further medical underwriting is required.

Death benefit payout depends on whether there has been a prior claim: either 100% of the Sum Assured or total premiums paid (whichever is higher) for no prior claims; for prior claims, the calculation is adjusted and excludes Diabetic Conditions Beneﬁt in the stated manner.

Diabetic Conditions Beneﬁt pays an additional 20% of the Death Benefit Sum Assured up to S$25,000 per condition per life and ceases once that additional portion is fully paid or when the policy terminates (whichever earlier). Only one claim can be made on the same Diabetic Condition.

Angioplasty & Other Invasive Treatment For Coronary Artery pays 10% of Sum Assured (subject to maximum claimable limit of S$25,000) and reduces the Sum Assured by the same amount; only once and payable as an early payout of the Death Beneﬁt. Other benefits continue based on the prevailing Sum Assured after that payment.
If there are no savings/investment features, there is no cash value if the policy ends or is terminated prematurely.

review_notes: TPD and Terminal Illness benefit triggers are stated at a high level, but the provided excerpt does not list their specific definitions; only the general lump-sum and the note that CI/TPD/Terminal are early payouts of the Death Benefit are extracted.

Only some of the 14 Critical Illness items are individually represented as benefit records; the brochure excerpt explicitly lists 14 and provides names, but does not provide separate payout formulas for each item beyond the general lump-sum statement and the specific diabetes and angioplasty mechanics.
